findings.claim: The exit-1 branch is chosen by the constant SKILL_PATHS_USAGE_EXIT, but its sentence writes the exit as the literal text "exited 1". If the constant changes, the denial will report an exit the engine did not give, which is the kind of misattribution correction D exists to remove. The literal also doubles the exit when the engine writes nothing to stderr. runEngine then fills in the failure as "the engine ended with exit 1" (:288), so the message reads "...the engine ended with exit 1; the engine <path> exited 1 on this plugin's call...". The "no line from the engine" row pins that wording. Interpolating ${reply.code} (or the constant) would keep the reported exit tied to the branch condition. L177 prescribes the exact sentence, so this is a maintainability note, not a deviation from the design.
